phone.title: Send a photo to your computer
phone.intro: Take a photo of your exercise or choose one. It goes straight to your question on the computer.
phone.noCode: This link has no code. Scan the QR code on your computer again.
phone.sent: Done! Go back to your computer: your photo is waiting there for you to add it.

stops.codeInvalid: This code has expired or has already been used. Make a new one on your computer.
stops.rateLimited: Too many tries right now. Wait a moment, then try again.
stops.blocked: This picture can't be sent. Make a new code on your computer and choose a different picture, or describe your question in words.
stops.tooLarge: This photo is too big. It can be up to {{limit}}. Choose another one.
stops.unsupported: Only photos can be sent from here. Choose a photo.
stops.empty: This photo is empty. Choose another one.
stops.unreadable: This photo could not be opened. Try another one, or a screenshot.
stops.retry: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
stops.newCode: That didn't work. Make a new code on your computer and try again.
